question: If (x)/(x² - 2x + 1) = (1)/(3) then the value of x³ + (1)/(x³) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divide the numerator and denominator of LHS by x to get: 1 / (x − 2 + 1/x) = 1/3

⇒ x + 1/x − 2 = 3 ⇒ x + 1/x = 5

Use the standard algebraic shortcut: If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k

⇒ Value = 5³ − 3 × 5 = 125 − 15 = 110

**∴ The correct answer is 110.**
